author: Ricardo Nogueira Garcia
releaseNotes: v1.1.0: incorporates John Land's "Improved" fork: new sirenOn/sirenOff/strobeOn/strobeOff commands (add or remove one component while the other keeps running), preference maxDuration renamed warningDuration (migrated automatically on Save), duration capped by the device-reported maxDuration, battery reporting configuration with cluster bind, zoneFlags attribute with warnings for battery low/defect and AC fault, CIE address check against the hub EUI, and logs for rejected writes and commands. v1.0.8: review suggestions from John Land (Hubitat Community): zone status notifications from the siren update zoneStatus, ZoneStatus decodes test and battery defect bits, 0xFF (invalid) battery and voltage readings are ignored, health checks are skipped while an alarm is active, autoOff event type is digital. v1.0.7: new batteryDiagnostics command and optional scheduled routine (reads power source, battery voltage/percentage/rated voltage and IAS Zone status), new powerSource and zoneStatus attributes, voltage history in state, unsupported attributes are logged. v1.0.6: the maxDuration attribute is written correctly again (v1.0.5 stored 58880 instead of 230), refresh also reads the battery voltage (new batteryVoltage attribute), and the IAS Zone enroll response is sent with sendHubCommand. v1.0.5: the driver answers the siren's IAS Zone enroll requests (it repeated them every 5 s), and the strobe is confirmed to flash continuously (strobeSupported is now "supported"). v1.0.4: fixes the strobe (strobe bit and payload field order), siren now uses the burglar warning mode, strobe-only command, new Health Check Siren/Strobe commands, alarm/switch reset when the duration ends, WarningDevice-EF-3.0 fingerprint, lastCheckin, and commands from installed()/updated() are now actually sent. maxDuration is limited to 1..600 s. Parts derived from gabriele-v's driver (Apache 2.0); credits to John Land for the v0.7 driver and review.

x-catalog.description: Zigbee driver for the Heiman HS2WD-E siren: alarm, strobe and tone control.
